findings.title: MatchExpIdentities returns true when only NotIn passes but In fails
findings.expected_behavior: For CSP/KSP selectors with both In and NotIn label expressions, a pod must match In and must not match NotIn.
findings.actual_behavior: After the In loop leaves matched=false, the NotIn loop sets matched=true on the last NonIdentity when no exclusion hit—even if In never matched.
findings.root_cause: NotIn-only success path does not gate on prior In match; CreateSecurityPolicy also drops NotIn when hasInOperator is already true.
findings.evidence: go test ./common -run TestMatchExpIdentities_InAndNotIn (temporary test on a95bfe7): FAIL not_in-set_and_not_excluded
findings.user_impact: Policies attach to wrong endpoints; controller-adjacent bookkeeping and telemetry attribute alerts to unintended workloads.

findings.title: WgDaemon does not track real monitor/feeder worker goroutines
findings.expected_behavior: DestroyKubeArmorDaemon should wait until TraceSyscall, UpdateLogs, CleanUpExitedHostPids, and gRPC ServeLogFeeds workers exit before tearing down BPF/monitor resources.
findings.actual_behavior: Wrapper functions Add(1) then immediately Done() after spawning workers with go; WgDaemon.Wait returns while workers still run.
findings.root_cause: WaitGroup attached to short-lived wrapper, not workers.
findings.evidence: Static analysis; aligns with open issue #2652 on main.
findings.user_impact: Graceful shutdown / rollouts may race with BPF map teardown (reliability, not bypass).
findings.regression_test_status: not_run (needs integration or controllable shutdown hook)

findings.title: monitor.StopChan is never closed on daemon shutdown
findings.expected_behavior: UpdateLogs and TraceSyscall exit when daemon shuts down.
findings.actual_behavior: Only core.StopChan is closed; monitor.StopChan is a separate channel never closed—workers rely on perf buffer close side effects.
findings.root_cause: Dual global StopChan design; DestroySystemMonitor does not close monitor.StopChan.
findings.evidence: grep close(StopChan) — single hit in core only.
findings.user_impact: Workers may not exit promptly; couples with KA-REL-002.

findings.title: KubeArmorPolicy controller Reconcile is a no-op
findings.expected_behavior: Controller updates policy CRD status or validation bookkeeping.
findings.actual_behavior: Immediate empty Result; all status is implicit via daemon logs.
findings.user_impact: Operators cannot read apply health from CRD; ops tooling gap.

findings.title: Local go test ./core fails without BPF code generation
findings.expected_behavior: Documented dev path: tests/core run after same steps as CI.
findings.actual_behavior: Fresh clone + go test ./core → setup failed missing probe_bpfel.o / llvm-strip.
findings.root_cause: go:embed BPF objects generated in CI, not in git.
findings.user_impact: Contributor friction; false sense that core is untested locally.

findings.title: Policy informer UpdateFunc may not insert missing policy
findings.expected_behavior: Resync MODIFIED should upsert into dm.SecurityPolicies.
findings.actual_behavior: Reported: update only replaces existing index; missing entry not inserted.
findings.evidence: Issue description; code structure matches update-only loop.
findings.user_impact: Stale or empty global policy list after resync edge cases.

findings.title: PodRefresher lists all pods and sleeps in reconcile
findings.expected_behavior: Per-request reconcile work bounded; use RequeueAfter not sleep.
findings.actual_behavior: Full cluster List each reconcile; time.Sleep(10s) and 5s in paths.
findings.user_impact: Controller worker blocking; slow annotation rollout at scale.
